look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the earlier films of this series.

scenes.name: Shape As Points
scenes.desc: Title beside our real SAP mesh.

scenes.name: The shape is the points
scenes.desc: The shape is stored as points with arrows; Poisson turns them into a surface.

scenes.name: Poisson in one step
scenes.desc: A live 2D run of the FFT Poisson solver: arrows, frequencies, field, outline.

scenes.name: Learning by doing
scenes.desc: Points to mesh to gap to the dots, and back: every step can be differentiated.

scenes.name: Sphere to body
scenes.desc: Our real run: a sphere of points becomes the body on grids of 32, 64, 128 and 256.

scenes.name: Our result
scenes.desc: 64,168 closed triangles in under 8 minutes, without our arrows.

scenes.name: On the MVS cloud
scenes.desc: Stray dots become small closed blobs.

scenes.name: Against the others
scenes.desc: SAP beside the six methods so far.

scenes.name: In one line
